channel.title: mint - markets
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Why Kaynes Technology shares crashed 20% to 52-week low? stock down 54% in a year | What stock market experts say
item.description: Kaynes Technology shares hit 20% lower circuit after Q2 FY27 net profit fell 61.6% year-on-year, despite modest revenue growth. Brokerages cited weakness in smart metering, rising debt and uneven segment performance, while auditor observations and financial restatements added to investor concerns.

item.title: Coal India’s Mahanadi Coalfields IPO expected profit calculator on GMP: What retail, HNI investors can gain on listing?
item.description: Mahanadi Coalfields set its IPO price band at ₹129–136 per share for an ₹8,981-crore offer for sale. At a grey market premium of ₹4.50, the estimated listing gain is 3.31%. A 110-share retail lot costs ₹14,960, with an estimated profit of ₹495.

item.title: Eicher races to meet Royal Enfield demand wave amid margin woes
item.description: Eicher’s shares have gained nearly 12% in the past year, vis-a-vis just a 2% rise in the Nifty Auto index. Triggers could be limited in the near term, given looming margin woes. Besides, a lean dealer inventory could strain financials until additional production capacity comes online.

item.title: Eicher Motors shares vroom like its Bullet, stock price jumps over 3%; what brokerages say post Q2; Buy or avoid? Target
item.description: Eicher Motors shares rose over 3% after it reported 15% year-on-year profit growth and record quarterly revenue of ₹7,422 crore. Royal Enfield motorcycle sales climbed 15% to a record 3.77 lakh units, while VECV sales increased 28.2%. Brokerages differed on valuation and near-term margin risks.

item.title: Inox Wind shares crash: Why energy stock price is falling today? Tanks 9.17% post Q2, down 60% in 1 year - Still a buy?
item.description: Inox Wind shares fell nearly 9.17% in Monday intraday trading after results showed a 42% annual drop in second-quarter net profit to ₹69 crore. Motilal Oswal cut its FY27 and FY28 EBITDA estimates and lowered its target price to ₹74, while retaining a Buy rating.

item.title: MCX gold, silver prices drop: What led to rates slide; multi-month lows ahead of wedding season - Details for investors
item.description: MCX gold and silver prices fell to multi-month lows as expectations of a US Federal Reserve rate hike, a stronger dollar and higher Treasury yields pressured precious metals. Silver hit a one-year low, while analysts say Indian wedding demand and central bank buying may help limit gold’s downside.

item.title: Tata Motors PV shares crash: What led to auto stock 8% ramming, Nifty laggard; down 27% in 2026 - Buy, sell or hold?
item.description: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles shares fell more than 8% after the company reported a September-quarter consolidated loss of ₹5,531 crore, despite revenue rising 34% year-on-year. Exceptional costs totalled ₹6,738 crore, while brokerages differed on the stock’s outlook and target prices.

item.title: Investors Return to JGBs as Rate Outlook Shifts, SMBC Nikko Says
item.description: Investors both at home and abroad are adding to positions in Japanese government debt as the surge in bond yields shows signs of peaking and concerns over artificial intelligence grow, according to SMBC Nikko Securities Inc.

item.title: Goldman Sachs Predicts ‘Sizeable Surplus’ for Oil Market in 2027
item.description: The oil market faces a “sizeable surplus” next year that’ll drag prices lower even as supply risks remain, Goldman Sachs Group Inc. said.

item.title: Coal India's Mahanadi Coalfields IPO price band set at ₹129 - ₹136 per share | Check GMP, issue details, key dates
item.description: Mahanadi Coalfields has set its IPO price band at ₹129–136 per share. The offer, open from 19 to 23 November, is a 10% stake sale by Coal India, which will receive the proceeds. Shares are tentatively due to list on BSE and NSE on 27 November.

item.title: Top stocks to watch today: Tata Motors PV, Eicher Motors, Hindalco shares in focus on Monday, 16 November | Full list
item.description: Indian markets may open higher on Monday as GIFT Nifty rose, despite cautious global cues. Investors will track quarterly results from Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles, Eicher Motors, Godrej Industries, Hero Motors and Zetwerk, alongside corporate deals, fundraising news and ex-dividend dates.

item.title: Stock market outlook today,16 Nov: Sensex, Nifty prediction-DJIA, S&P, NASDAQ, GIFT Nifty, Kospi, Nikkei, Taiwan cues
item.description: Sensex and Nifty 50 are expected to open flat to positive on Monday, despite weaker Asian markets and mixed global cues. Indian benchmarks fell on Friday as higher-than-expected retail inflation raised concerns about a possible RBI rate hike.

item.description: GLOBAL-FOREX/:FOREX-Yen steady against euro and dollar after soft Japanese GDP data

item.title: Hitachi Energy’s growth outlook powers rally. Have valuations run ahead?
item.description: A strong earnings performance, robust order inflows and confidence in long-term demand sent Hitachi Energy shares soaring. The company expects growth to be supported by upcoming HVDC projects and continued investments in power transmission.

item.description: Market expert Raja Venkatraman shares his top stock picks for 16 November. Here’s his technical outlook and trade strategy.

item.title: Stock recommendations for 16 November from MarketSmith India
item.description: MarketSmith India reveals its top stock recommendations for today, 16 November. Get expert insights into the best-performing stocks to guide your investment decisions.

item.title: Too early to call FII return to Indian equities a trend, says Sundaram AMC's Radhakrishnan
item.description: Anand Radhakrishnan says lower crude prices, steadier currency, attractive valuations and better-than-expected earnings offer more durable reasons for the renewed interest than a global retreat from AI stocks.

item.title: Markets poised for a breather after sharp rally
item.description: Options data implies an initial decline toward 24800 and upside target of 25400 through Tuesday&nbsp;

item.title: Retail Crowd Dump Vietnam Stocks for Near 10% Bank-Deposit Rates
item.description: Vietnam’s retail investors are dumping equities and buying high-yielding notes from banks to capture interest rates nearing 10%, as locals and foreigners fall out of favor with the poor-performing stock market.

item.title: Emerging-Market Assets Dip as Chip Rout, Fed Rate Worries Linger
item.description: Emerging-market assets fell on Friday as a rout in chipmakers weighed on equities and lingering concerns over the Federal Reserve’s rate path kept currencies under pressure.

item.title: Wall Street Week Ahead: Nvidia earnings, Anthropic IPO, Federal Reserve minutes, retail sales - Top things to watch
item.description: Nvidia's earnings announcement on Tuesday will be among the biggest events of the week, as investors look for indications that demand for AI infrastructure remains strong amid concerns over the sustainability of massive investments in the sector

item.title: Watrana Rentals IPO GMP profit calculator on latest GMP: How much profit can retail and HNI investors expect?
item.description: Watrana Rentals’ ₹120.10 crore SME IPO will open on November 19 and close on November 23. The fresh issue comprises 49.02 lakh shares, with a price band of ₹232–245 and a lot size of 600 shares. The IPO is expected to list on NSE SME on November 27.

item.title: Multibagger small cap stock delivers 91% return in 1 year! IDBI Capital sees 17% upside - Do you own? Check target price
item.description: Rolex Rings shares have gained 91% over the past year. IDBI Capital maintained a Buy rating and set a target price of ₹241, citing the company’s growth prospects from the Make in India ecosystem, rising capacity utilisation and strong quarterly results.

item.title: 144% return in 6 months: Multibagger to turn 1 stock into 18 after split, bonus- Do you own it? Check ratio, return
item.description: SC Agrotech shares have surged, gaining 144% in six months and 266% in a year. The company has proposed a 1:10 stock split and a 4:5 bonus issue, which would turn each existing share into 18 shares. The record date for both actions is yet to be announced.

item.title: Stock to buy after Q2 Results 2026: Up 70% in YTD! Should you buy retail stock after strong guidance? Target, stop-loss
item.description: Baazar Style Retail shares rose 5.39% on Friday and gained about 20% in a week ahead of the company’s Q2 FY27 results. Revenue from operations declined year over year to ₹47,848.31 lakh.&nbsp;

item.title: Crystal Crop Protection IPO one lot profit calculator on latest GMP: How much can retail and HNI investors earn? Listing
item.description: Crystal Crop Protection’s ₹455.49 crore IPO opens November 18 and closes November 20, with shares priced at ₹259– ₹272. The latest grey market premium of ₹14 suggests a potential listing price of ₹286, or a 5.15% gain at the upper price band.

item.title: Gold, silver prices ahead of wedding season: Down over 4% this week - Investors guide before US Fed Dec meeting
item.description: Gold and silver futures recovered slightly on Friday but posted steep weekly losses as hotter US inflation, a stronger dollar and rising bond yields heightened expectations of a Fed rate hike. Analysts see near-term pressure, while Indian wedding demand and central-bank buying may cushion gold.

item.title: Stock market outlook, November 16-20: Nifty logs 3-week winning streak, first since June - Rally ahead or a pause?
item.description: Indian equities may extend their rally during November 16–20, though volatility is expected. Strong foreign inflows, earnings and bullish technical momentum support the outlook, while crude prices, the rupee, geopolitical tensions and US policy signals pose risks.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty cheer as Bulls, FPIs back in Indian stock market; pump in over ₹84k cr in Nov so far - More rally ahead?
item.description: FPIs invested ₹84,291 crore in Indian equities in November, helping the Sensex and Nifty extend their recovery and drawing buying into broader markets. Analysts cite earnings growth, reasonable valuations and global portfolio shifts as drivers.

item.title: Sebi to issue AI guidelines for capital markets soon, focus on investor protection and human oversight
item.description: The regulator plans safeguards on AI disclosures, accountability and decision-making; cybersecurity framework also under review

item.title: PSU dividend this week Nov 16-20: Cochin Shipyard, Power Finance Corp, SCI to Oil India - Check record dates and returns
item.description: Four PSU stocks will attract attention this week as investors track dividend record dates: Cochin Shipyard and Shipping Corporation of India on November 16, Power Finance Corporation on November 17, and Oil India on November 20. Their announced dividends range from ₹3 to ₹7 per share.

item.title: Coal India's Mahanadi Coalfields IPO: Stage set for launch, price band tomorrow; GMP, allotment, listing, other details
item.description: Mahanadi Coalfields, Coal India’s largest coal-producing subsidiary, will open its IPO for subscription from 19 to 23 November. The offer is a sale of up to 66.18 crore shares by Coal India, expected to raise about ₹9,500 crore. The price band is yet to be announced.

item.title: Nifty 50 above 25,000, holds key moving averages: Is Buy-On-Dips right strategy? Here's what stock market experts say
item.description: Indian markets fell on Friday after retail inflation rose to 6.09%, above the RBI’s tolerance limit, but analysts said the broader technical outlook remains positive. They cited support around 24,850–24,900 and recommended buying on dips if key levels hold.
